events.title: New Tool in the Heritage Flipper Demo: The Replanker!
events.summary: Steam Next Fest is here, and the Heritage Flipper demo just got biggerMeet the Replanker, our newest tool. Pull up old, worn floor planks and broken fence boards, then lay down fresh wood and watch the place come back to life. It joins the tools you already know: the pressure washer, sandblaster, paint, grass trimmer, and more. Even more ways to restore old homes, inside and out.Prefer to play from the couch? events.summary: You've just spent an hour sandblasting centuries of grime off an ancient stone wall. The texture underneath is raw, warm, and full of history.
